discovery.none: Manual selection is required until a product-specific matcher exists. A201 service data and company 0x07D0 identify only the Tuya platform, not an Adaprox Fingerbot, and the generic BLE schema/mobile matcher has no service_data key. device.name: Adaprox Fingerbot / Fingerbot Plus (BLE)
device.notes:
This entry covers only the three reported protocol-3 product IDs and DP layouts below. It does not infer support from a generic Fingerbot name or the generic A201 + 0x07D0 Tuya advertisement. Manual product-ID/GATT confirmation is required; A201 is documentary platform evidence only. The protocol-3 GATT layout is service 0x1910, write 0x2B11 and notify 0x2B10; the association between a physical model, product ID, DP layout and GATT layout remains reported until a device-info/GATT dump is collected. Other Tuya protocol generations and other button-pushers are deliberately outside this entry.
A stock unit must first be bound in the vendor app. Local control then needs its device ID and cloud-issued local key. The first six local-key characters are the v3 secret: login_key = MD5(secret), and the session key is MD5(secret || the six-byte device_random returned by device-info). Every normal DP write needs that stateful encrypted session, so the commands below are documentation for a dedicated handler, not fixed GATT writes for a generic renderer.

openness.notes: The protocol was recovered by community implementations and vendor-app research, not published as an Adaprox local API. No vendor source or app artifact is included here.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: A factory-fresh/reset unit advertises for binding. For an already-bound unit the established route is vendor-app unbind/reset; no universal physical hold is asserted.

exclusivity.notes: Single connection is reported platform behavior, not project-verified model behavior. single_bond refers to the one vendor binding, not an OS Bluetooth bond.
exclusivity.recovery: Close the vendor app/other local client and reconnect. If the unit belongs to another account, its owner must unbind it or it must be reset; a new binding replaces the local credential.

pin.notes: There is no Bluetooth PIN; authorization is the per-device vendor credential and encrypted PAIR/session exchange.

unpair.clears: The vendor binding and current local credential; schedule survival is not established.
unpair.notes: Unbinding and reset are the same established route here; there is no separate non-destructive local unpair operation.

safety_advisory.detail: Keep the mechanism and the controlled appliance under direct observation during any actuation or scheduled-program test. Do not test on a heater, cooker, door, power tool or other load whose unexpected operation could cause harm. This spec is identify_only because a dedicated encrypted session handler is required; it does not offer unattended actuation.
safety_advisory.summary: A Fingerbot moves a real arm and can operate whatever button or switch it is mounted on.

credentials.notes: The local key is a password equivalent. Do not log it, PAIR payloads, device_random-derived session keys, real MAC addresses or owner account data. The vector below uses an invented key only.

factory_reset.effect: Removes the vendor binding and invalidates the current local session credential. A later binding issues replacement credentials. Whether all stored timers/week programs survive is unknown; do not use reset as a schedule-clearing operation.

steps.action: Send device-info function 0x0000 with security flag 4, derive the session key from the returned six-byte device_random, then complete PAIR function 0x0001.

setup.notes: Initial binding needs the vendor app/account. Later local sessions need the device ID and local key extracted once from the owner's Tuya IoT project. No Wi-Fi credential exists on the Fingerbot itself.

rejoin.notes: There is no Wi-Fi network to rejoin. Moving to another vendor account means unbind/reset, bind again, export the replacement device ID/local key and establish a new local session.

testing.notes: No Fingerbot, GATT dump, pairing session, motor actuation or firmware update was exercised by this project. Product layouts and the vendor fragment-nibble difference are reported research; the only local checks are independent encodings of the synthetic vectors below.

variants.notes: Reported original Fingerbot product. Uses layout original_tenths below; confirm with a device-info/DP dump.
Reported Adaprox built-in-battery/USB-C product. Uses layout adaprox_low_schedule below; this schedule association still needs a dump.
Reported ADFB0301 Plus product. Uses layout plus_seconds below, including whole-second sustain time and DP121 loop support.

initialization.notes: Notifications are fragments, not complete packets; reassemble before decryption.

initialization.description: Run device-info 0x0000 under login_key with security flag 4, read the six-byte device_random, derive session_key = MD5(secret || device_random), then use security flag 5 for PAIR and normal DP traffic. This stateful exchange cannot be represented as fixed initialization bytes.

Independent synthetic crypto/CRC/fragment and DP/raw-schedule vectors

local_access.summary: After one-time vendor binding/key export, protocol-3 monitoring and control are technically local over BLE. This catalogue entry is identify_only because the mobile app has no dedicated stateful Tuya session handler and every actuation requires attendance, not because the vendor protocol is a cloud-only LAN API.

action_dp.notes: Read DP8 and current state first. DP2 is the push operation for every covered layout, not merely a switch toggle.

invert_dp.notes: Reverse up/down meaning in switch mode; not an unattended calibration command.

tap_enable_dp.notes: Tap enable is reported on original ltak7e1p and Plus, not Plus-only and not asserted for y6kttvd6.

original_alternative_click.decode: DP101 BOOL length 1 true = original ltak7e1p reported alternative only

original_sustain_5_seconds.decode: DP10 VALUE raw 50 -> 5.0 s at scale 0.1

plus_sustain_5_seconds.decode: DP10 VALUE raw 5 -> 5 s at scale 1

push.decode: DP2 BOOL length 1 true = attended push in push mode

alternative_click_dp.scope: Original ltak7e1p only, reported alternative to DP2 push per ha_tuya_ble issue #9; not asserted for the other products and not a second write after DP2.

dp_layouts.selection: Select by product ID and confirm against a device-info/DP dump before any write; never try layouts by actuating the arm.

week_program.days_enable: One opaque weekday-mask/enable byte for this spec; bit-to-weekday ordering is unresolved and deliberately not guessed

synthetic_vector.note: 0x81 is an encoding fixture only, not a weekday assertion

legacy_asb_abb_plaintext.notes: This optional plaintext note is not the Tuya encrypted DP protocol above and is not SwitchBot's protocol. Do not send these frames to 0x2B11, do not wrap them in AES/Tuya fragmentation, and do not treat a SwitchBot parser as an ASB/ABB implementation. No commands are declared.
legacy_asb_abb_plaintext.transport: Legacy ASB/ABB serial/BLE profile; service UUIDs, discovery, code meanings and model applicability are not established

advertisement.notes: Documentary Tuya-platform evidence only; do not assume an advertised GATT service UUID or broadcast arm/battery state.
advertisement.selection: Manual product-ID and protocol-3 GATT confirmation until a product-specific matcher exists; another Tuya product with the same A201/0x07D0 evidence must not select this spec.

authentication.pair_payload: UUID || six-character secret || device ID, zero-padded to 44 bytes; UUID is not a session-KDF input
authentication.secret: ASCII bytes of the first six characters of the 16-character local key

security_flags.5: session_key for PAIR and normal DP traffic

authentication.session_key: MD5(secret || device_random), where device_random is exactly six bytes from device-info

dp_records.layout: [DP id u8][type u8][payload length u8][payload, exactly length bytes]
dp_records.scope: Protocol-3 records only; do not generalize to DP_V4
dp_records.signedness: Decode VALUE/ENUM as signed big-endian integers of the declared length; encode VALUE writes as signed four-byte big-endian
dp_records.types: RAW=0x00, BOOL=0x01, VALUE=0x02, STRING=0x03, ENUM=0x04, BITMAP=0x05

fragmentation.first_write: [packet number varint = 0][total encrypted-envelope length varint][protocol nibble][envelope bytes...]
fragmentation.later_writes: [monotonically increasing packet number varint][next envelope bytes...]
fragmentation.nibble_discrepancy: Vendor protocol-3 framing reports 0x20 while the maintained community implementation emits protocol_version << 4, hence 0x30 for v3. Preserve this as an unresolved interoperability difference; do not silently normalize captures. The frozen concatenated writes below retain 0x30.
fragmentation.reassembly: Buffer exactly the declared envelope length across independent writes; reject missing/out-of-order/oversized fragments rather than decrypting a prefix
fragmentation.varint: Unsigned LEB128/base-128, seven payload bits per byte, continuation bit 0x80; at most four bytes for packet number and five for total length

device_info.description: Synthetic independent vector; no real device, account or credential. Concatenate the two GATT writes to compare with expected_concatenated_writes_hex.

wire.crc: CRC-16/MODBUS: reflected polynomial 0xA001, initial 0xFFFF, no final xor, over sequence through data; append the resulting u16 big-endian
wire.encryption: AES-128-CBC under the flag-selected key and a fresh random 16-byte IV; encrypted envelope is [security flag u8][IV 16][ciphertext]
wire.padding: Append zero bytes after CRC to the next AES block boundary; no padding-length byte and no extra block when already aligned
wire.plaintext: [sequence u32be][response-to u32be][function u16be][data length u16be][data][CRC16 u16be]
wire.validation: After decryption require sufficient bytes, exact declared data length and matching CRC; discard only zero padding after the two CRC bytes

remaining_unknowns: Real GATT and device-info dumps tying each physical model/product ID to the reported protocol-3 GATT and DP layout, especially y6kttvd6's DP3/4-7 schedule mapping.
Whether devices accept fragment nibble 0x20, 0x30, or both; preserve and test each rather than silently normalizing.
Weekday bit ordering and the enable bit in the week-program days+enable byte, plus DP121 loop representation outside the reported Plus profile.
Physical factory-reset behavior, schedule survival across reset/rebinding, and connection limits across all three products.
Protocol 4 and CubeTouch are deliberately out of scope and need separate evidence/specs, not fallback mappings here.
Legacy ASB/ABB transport UUIDs, product applicability and code/payload semantics; its plaintext framing is not a Tuya or SwitchBot command surface.
Model-specific OTA image format, signature enforcement and interrupted-update recovery.

device_info.description: Read device info with function 0x0000 and security flag 4; derive the session key from the returned six-byte device_random.

device_reset.advanced_reason: Resets the vendor binding and may affect stored configuration; back up credentials/settings first.
device_reset.description: DEVICE_RESET function 0x0006; schedule survival and physical reset behavior are unverified.

dp_query.description: Query current DPs with function 0x0002; decode reports on 0x2B10 without triggering the arm.

ota_transfer.advanced_reason: A wrong or interrupted image can disable the actuator's radio. No production update or recovery claim is made.
ota_transfer.description: Reported Tuya OTA functions 0x000C-0x0010 inside the encrypted session; exact image/package behavior is not established for these products.

pair.description: Complete PAIR function 0x0001 under security flag 5 with the owner UUID, six-character secret and device ID padded to 44 bytes.

press.advanced_reason: Moves the actuator and the attached button/switch. Use only with the mechanism and controlled appliance under direct observation.
press.description: Attended push using DP2 BOOL true in push/click mode for every covered layout. Read DP8 first; do not send DP101 as an additional push.

press_original_alternative.advanced_reason: Moves the original Fingerbot arm. Use only after confirming ltak7e1p and observing the mechanism; never try it to identify a unit.
press_original_alternative.description: Original ltak7e1p only: reported DP101 BOOL alternative to DP2 push per ha_tuya_ble issue #9. Not asserted for other products and never an extra write after DP2.

program_action.advanced_reason: Starts or stops physical programmed actuation. Attend the entire first run on an inert installation.
program_action.description: Attended DP2 BOOL write in program mode to start/stop the loaded program; read DP8 and the current program state first.

set_loop.advanced_reason: Can repeat physical actuation without further commands. Test only on an inert installation with a person present to stop it.
set_loop.description: Set the reported DP121 loop control on plus_seconds after reading its current representation; no category-kg adaptive-movement meaning is imported.

set_mode.advanced_reason: Changes actuator behavior and can make a later write move the arm unexpectedly; attend and verify the mechanical installation.
set_mode.description: Set DP8 ENUM: 0 click/push, 1 switch, 2 program. This changes how the mode-dependent DP2 action behaves; DP101 remains only the original product's reported alternative.

set_movement.advanced_reason: Changes physical travel and may make the arm strike or overdrive the attached control; adjust only while observing clearance.
set_movement.description: Set down movement DP9 and up movement DP15 as percentages using the selected product layout; read current values before changing either.

set_sustain.advanced_reason: Changes how long the arm holds the attached control; an incorrect layout can multiply the hold by ten.
set_sustain.description: Set DP10 using the selected layout's scale: 0.1 s/raw unit for original_tenths and adaprox_low_schedule, 1 s/raw unit for plus_seconds.

set_timer.advanced_reason: Schedules unattended physical actuation. Use an inert test installation and attend the first firing.
set_timer.description: Write one raw timer [operation u8][seconds u32be] to DP3 on adaprox_low_schedule or DP111 on the other layouts; a timer can later actuate without a phone.

set_week_program.advanced_reason: Creates recurring unattended physical actuation. Keep the first schedule under observation and do not guess weekday bits.
set_week_program.description: Write [operation u8][days+enable u8][hour u8][minute u8][second u8] to DP4-7 on adaprox_low_schedule or DP112-115 on the other layouts; weekday bit ordering is not asserted.

toggle.advanced_reason: Changes and physically operates the attached switch. Attend the action and verify the current DP mode/state first.
toggle.description: Attended DP2 BOOL write in switch mode; state/mode must be read first so this does not produce an unintended second actuation.

unbind.advanced_reason: Removes local access until the unit is bound again and replacement credentials are exported.
unbind.description: UNBIND function 0x0005; invalidates the current vendor/local credential.

characteristics.name: Encrypted host writes
characteristics.notes: Logical packets follow protocol_details.tuya_ble_v3. Commands have no value/template deliberately: sequence, response correlation, IV, session key and fragmentation are connection state, not constants.

characteristics.name: Encrypted notifications
characteristics.notes: Reassemble varint fragments, select the key by security flag, verify CRC16/MODBUS before consuming the declared data, and ignore zero padding after the two CRC bytes. DP reports use function 0x8001; time requests 0x8011/0x8012 need a response for schedules to keep the intended clock.

services.name: Tuya BLE protocol-3 service (reported model mapping)
services.notes: This is the only GATT service declared for this Adaprox entry. Do not replace it with a service from another Tuya protocol generation. The physical-model association remains pending a real GATT/device-info dump.
